observations: Photo 0 shows a white sewing machine with a red control panel and a digital display, placed on a textured surface with a ruler in the background.
Photo 1 is a similar angle to photo 0, showing the same machine from a slightly different perspective.
Photo 2 shows a close-up of a label on the machine's base, which reads 'MADE IN TAIWAN' and includes a CE mark and other small text.
The machine appears to be a mini-monogram machine, as suggested by the seller's words and the design.
The control panel has a grid of buttons and a small screen, typical of embroidery machines.
The machine shows some minor scuffs and dust, consistent with use.
No power cord or accessories are visible in any photo.
